entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:1
segments: ¶How beautiful are thy footsteps in sandals, O prince's daughter! The roundings of thy thighs are like jewels, The work of the hands of an artist.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:2
segments: Thy navel is a round goblet, [which] wanteth not mixed wine; Thy belly a heap of wheat, set about with lilies;

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:3
segments: Thy two breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle;

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:4
segments: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory; Thine eyes, [like] the pools in Heshbon, By the gate of Bath-rabbim; Thy nose like the tower of Lebanon, Which looketh toward Damascus;

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:5
segments: Thy head upon thee is like Carmel, And the locks of thy head like purple; The king is fettered by [thy] ringlets!

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:6
segments: How fair and how pleasant art thou, [my] love, in delights!

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:7
segments: This thy stature is like to a palm-tree, And thy breasts to grape clusters.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:8
segments: I said, I will go up to the palm-tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof; And thy breasts shall indeed be like clusters of the vine, And the fragrance of thy nose like apples,

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:9
segments: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine, ...That goeth down smoothly for my beloved, And stealeth over the lips of them that are asleep.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:10
segments: ¶I am my beloved's, And his desire is toward me.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:11
segments: --Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the fields; Let us lodge in the villages.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:12
segments: We will go up early to the vineyards, We will see if the vine hath budded, [If] the blossom is opening, And the pomegranates are in bloom: There will I give thee my loves.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:13
segments: The mandrakes yield fragrance; And at our gates are all choice fruits, new and old: I have laid them up for thee, my beloved.
